name: Hearts and Herbs
source:
A short and simple visual-novel-esque game as a lite dating-sim made in Twine 2 sugarcube.  Made for 2018 Pastel Jam.

[From [url=https://foulfowlplay.itch.io/hearts-and-herbs] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款短小简单的视觉小说式游戏，是一款用Twine 2 Sugarcube制作的精简版约会模拟游戏。专为2018年Pastel Jam制作。

[来自[url=https://foulfowlplay.itch.io/hearts-and-herbs] itch.io[/url]]
